`
` cannot appear in an `extern` block's library name
label: this name is written into the emitted module and passed to the linker as `-l<name>`
notes: the name is emitted verbatim into the module beside the block's declares, where a `;` comment ends at the first newline
help: a library name is the stem of `lib<name>.a`, so it is `[A-Za-z0-9._+-]` and nothing else - `axiom_demo`, `m`, `c++abi`; pass a directory with `--link-search DIR` rather than encoding one here, and name the boundary symbol in the item's own `(symbol "...")` clause
